findings.evidence: p.46 (Ch 2 §2.5): "actual sustained bandwidth for weight-read kernels may be 60–80% of peak [2° rule-of-thumb; not measured here]"
findings.issue: Missing Axis 2 (epistemic status) tag on a load-bearing quantitative claim. The convention (p.17) states 'Every load-bearing quantitative claim carries Axes 1 and 2 as an inline pair (e.g. [1P][DERIVED]).' This claim carries only Axis 1 ([2°]) with a descriptive qualifier ('rule-of-thumb; not measured here') but no formal Axis 2 tag such as [HYPOTHESIS] or [FACT]. The qualifier 'not measured here' most closely corresponds to [HYPOTHESIS].
findings.fix_instruction: Change '[2° rule-of-rule; not measured here]' to '[2°][HYPOTHESIS]' with the 'not measured here' qualifier in surrounding prose, to comply with the two-axis label-pair convention.

findings.evidence: The resource model (the book's recurring framework). Inference consumes several fundamentally different resources, and the single most useful habit an architect can build is to name which one a given optimization or bottleneck is about.
findings.issue: The book introduces a seven-row 'resource' table (compute capacity, memory bandwidth, memory capacity, interconnect bandwidth/latency, scheduling capacity, latency budget, throughput/goodput) but never gives it a number. Subsequent chapters refer to it implicitly ('name the resource it targets and the resource it costs', 'the optimization decision map (Ch. 15) is this framework read backwards'). Ch. 15's map is referenced as if it were a numbered artifact, but no figure or table in the List of Figures is labelled 'optimization decision map' — Fig 15.1 is 'FlashAttention: the same math, far less HBM traffic' and Fig 15.2 is 'Two levers, two serving phases.' The pointer does not resolve to a titled artifact.
findings.fix_instruction: Number the resource table (e.g. Table 2-2) and reference it by number in Ch. 15 and Ch. 2. In Ch. 15, either title the actual optimization-decision-map artifact (give it a figure number and list it in the List of Figures) or replace the pointer with the concrete figure numbers ('§15.1, Figs 15.1–15.2').

findings.evidence: Written as a sum, end-to-end TTFT is TTFTe2e = retrieval + admission/queue + tokenization/transfer + prefill.
findings.issue: Label mismatch on the sentence's leading tag. The sentence is tagged '[ILLUSTRATIVE definitional]' but it is not a hypothetical worked example — it is the book's stated timing convention, used verbatim in Ch. 4 §4.3 and quoted by the Preface. The book's tag definitions (Preface p. 17) say '[ILLUSTRATIVE] is reserved for a non-canonical hypothetical worked example: its inputs are [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] and its derived results [ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED]'. A definitional convention carrying an [ILLUSTRATIVE] tag is a category error, and '[ILLUSTRATIVE definitional]' is not one of the book's declared Axis 1 values at all.
findings.fix_instruction: Retag as '[definitional] — the book's TTFT convention (Ch. 2, quoted in Ch. 4 §4.3 and the Preface)' with no Axis 1 provenance tag, or introduce a documented convention (e.g. '[CONVENTION]') in the Sources chapter's label-rule table so the form is legitimate.
